review_scope: Claret with parallel fine golden curved lines bending across the torso, navy/gold cuffs and matching ring edge. Curves adapted from worn front; exact distortion is not copied. Independent current variant front inspected. All sponsors, manufacturer marks, club crests and lettering removed. Colors are estimates; original PNG fabric/alpha and existing round collar are preserved.
limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
